attributes.additional_details: Any time u ring them dvla u get put in a que that takes hours upon hours and once u finally get through u give u them your details and the same stupid answer is given that we cannot provide u with the time or even how long it will be. It is unfair for the people who have disabilities and many other conditions.if it was a normal license it would have come within a day but for us its 1-3 years enough is enough it is time for a change with the dvla.
attributes.background: its time to Fix DVLA medical licence delays. UK applicants wait months or years and all they get is the same answer all the time. No updates no times just the lousy answer. We need to change the DVLA we need them to tell us how long our provisonal or normal licenses will be cause enough is enough.

rejection.details:
We already have a couple of petitions on issues relating to medical licence reinstatement and broader process & performance delays in the DVLA, which you may wish to sign: 

Review DVLA’s performance & processes, increase funding & create governing body
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/767750

Review DVLA processes for Medical Licence Reinstatement
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785165
